verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents an OpenAI-compatible API and tool/function calling that lets you 'build agents that access APIs, retrieve real-time data, or perform actions,' which is the technical basis for agent-framework compatibility, but the evidence pack has no first-party guide specifically naming or walking through integration with coding agents or agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Cursor, Continue, AutoGPT). Missing for 10: explicit named integration guides for specific coding agents/agent frameworks, and independent confirmation that such integrations work in practice.
